issues.jp_before: 私[わたし]{の|no-possessive}妹[いもうと]{が/の|ga-sub-clause}好[す]きな歌手[かしゅ]{は|wa-topic}有名[ゆうめい]です。
issues.problem: Distractor を gives a grammatical sentence (妹を好きな歌手 'the singer who likes my sister'); risky as a distractor.
issues.action: Replaced distractor を with で.

issues.jp_before: どの電車[でんしゃ]{が|ga-sub-clause}一番[いちばん]早[はや]い{か|ka-embedded}、調[しら]べましょう。
issues.problem: 早い means early, but the English says 'fastest' (速い).
issues.action: Changed 早[はや]い to 速[はや]い.

issues.jp_before: 空[そら]{が|ga-sub-clause}暗[くら]くなる{と|to-conditional}、星[ほし]{が/は|ga-subject}見[み]えます。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot: が with 見える is the catalog's ga-sense skill, not ga-subject.

issues.jp_before: 天気[てんき]{が/の|ga-sub-clause}いい日[ひ]{は|wa-topic}、ここ{から|kara-from}富士山[ふじさん]{が|ga-subject}見[み]えます。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot: が with 見える is ga-sense, and は is equally natural there but was not listed.

issues.jp_before: 子[こ]ども{が|ga-sub-clause}眠[ねむ]い{ので/から|node-because}、今日[きょう]{は|wa-topic}早[はや]く帰[かえ]りましょう。
issues.problem: The feeling adjective 眠い with a third-person subject is not good model Japanese; 眠そう is standard.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 眠[ねむ]そうな{ので|node-because} (から is dropped because it would need だから), changed the English to 'looks sleepy' and updated why.

issues.jp_before: 魚[さかな]{が|ga-sub-clause}新鮮[しんせん]な{ので|node-because}、この店[みせ]{は/が|wa-topic}人気[にんき]{が|ga-stative}あります。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot: 人気がある is ある of possession/existence, not the 好き/分かる-type ga-stative.
